messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it"
set: ["doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it", "review should determine the need for maintenance treatment", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "you may need a higher dose for a short time", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "you should be given a medication guide each time you fill a prescription", "children should use it for the shortest amount of time necessary to achieve symptom relief", "adrenal glands need time to restart hormone production after steroid use", "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose", "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "if you switched to fluticasone from another steroid medicine you should not stop using it suddenly", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "ask doctor for safer medicine during this time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
